categories.hierarchy: Hierarchy: the most important thing on the screen reads first
categories.typography: Typography: type size, weight, line length and rhythm
categories.layout: Layout and spacing: alignment, grouping, density, breathing room
categories.colour: Colour and contrast, in light and dark
categories.copy: Copy clarity: every label and message says what it means in plain words
categories.steps: Steps to finish a task: how few clicks and screens the flow takes with the mouse, never counting on a keyboard shortcut
categories.overlay-speed: How fast the Overlay reads mid-call: can you take it in with a glance while talking
categories.proactive: Help without asking: the right answer, insight, suggestion or Visual arrives before the user has to ask, and stays out of the way when there is nothing to add
categories.consistency: Consistency across surfaces: the same thing looks and behaves the same everywhere
categories.polish: Craft and polish: edges, states, icons, details

rules: Hidden mode stays out of shares and never takes focus: judge it on the design (Hidden mode is shown, and no surface needs focus or relies on being seen in a share); a screenshot cannot prove capture, so Native E2E proves the behaviour and an unproven capture is not a break
No action needs a keyboard shortcut: every action has a visible control, and shortcut labels show only in tooltips and Settings, Shortcuts

flows.flow:heard: A question is asked in the meeting and Shrewd answers it unasked
flows.flow:visual: The meeting talks through a process or system, a Visual builds as it goes, and the user presents it
flows.flow:past-decision: Find what was decided in a past Session
flows.flow:coaching: Read a Live coaching cue and act on it
flows.flow:follow-up: Finish a Session and prepare the follow-up in your mail app
flows.flow:retro: Read the Retro after a Session and see how it went
